requiredInvariants: All v15 transport, dynamic table ownership, SOF DQT transfer, first-SOS release, actual coefficient geometry, dynamic Huffman, render-only quantization widening, packed progression, restart, preview, live-Y boundary and EOI-compaction invariants remain unchanged.

Canonical progression is monotone: Ah=0 may touch only unseen coefficients; once an entry is established, only refinement with Ah equal to the previous Al may touch it, and progression value 0 is terminal. Duplicate first scans fail closed in one-shot and incremental paths.

For every qualified 4:2:0 render arena, rowStateBytes equals exactly 16*yRowStrideBytes + 18*chromaRowStrideBytes: 16 Y strip rows, 8 Cb rows, 8 Cr rows and prior Cb/Cr rows. Neither a deferred Y row nor full-width reconstructed Cb/Cr staging rows are allocated.

Centered H2V2 and box chroma reconstruction are fused directly into the existing integer YCbCr-to-RGB conversion. Unit evidence must match the historical staged reconstruction plus planar RGB path byte-for-byte.

The 576x576 multi-iMCU source must retain the frozen RGB SHA256 5b1738e18c84104586fbe59f37348d8bf1fd9af2cd7036874f156625549bafbb; incremental-versus-complete self-agreement is not sufficient because both paths share the renderer.
Persistent state and maximum retained authority are unchanged from v15. Render scratch decreases by exactly two yRowStrideBytes per source: 128 bytes for tiny/restart64 and 1152 bytes for noise576.
The tiny source has rowStateBytes 2176, renderScratchBytes 2688, totalStateBytes 6432, final-ready retained 897 bytes, maximum retained authority 5055 bytes and operation peak 7743 bytes.

The 576x576 source has rowStateBytes 14976, renderScratchBytes 15488, totalStateBytes 1013280, final-ready retained 995328 bytes, maximum retained authority 998206 bytes and operation peak 2009022 bytes.
The restart64 source has rowStateBytes 2176, renderScratchBytes 2688, totalStateBytes 17440, final-ready retained 12288 bytes, maximum retained authority 15166 bytes and operation peak 30142 bytes.

Pre-frame/frame-q/Huffman high-water, transport, entropy rollback, source hashes and final RGB values remain identical to v15. This version removes render staging and tightens canonical progression without widening the qualified source domain.

This profile does not qualify malloc headers, allocator size classes, Swift object/pointer fields, physical RSS, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes or perceptual reconstruction quality.
